description: Research data supporting "Increasing the value of bridge SHM data by leveraging network-level open data is a data set deposited in bl.cam by its authors Paul Ronald Alan Fidler, Sam Cocking. The dataset contains data relating to two bridges, known during construction as Bridge IB5 and Bridge UB11. Both were built in 2015 as part of the Stafford Area Improvement Project - a joint venture between Network Rail, Atkins, Laing O'Rourke, and Volker Rail. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
